newsitem.title: USA: Belarus structural reform lagging, official says.
newsitem.headline: Belarus structural reform lagging, official says.

text.p: Belarus has made progress in liberalising its foreign exchange market, but has done little to launch the structural reforms needed to transform its economy, an international monetary official said on Tuesday.
The official told Reuters more liberal foreign exchange market had allowed a welcome decline in the Belarus.
"The currency correction has been good and the budget situation is not bad, but ... there are very few signs of progress on the structural side," he said.

The IMF has frozen payments on a $300 million standby loan to the former Soviet republic of Belarus and World Bank officials have criticized Minsk's sluggish reforms and said that one fifth of the population was living in poverty.
